detail: Verified current upstream codex-mcp/plugin_config.rs and agent_plugin_config.rs. Use legacy npx launch with inherited session cwd for automatic startup. Include a self-contained bundle and absolute-path codex mcp add recipe for offline use. Do not use portable cwd or cache-directory scanning; either can target the wrong Twining store.
summary: Legacy Codex MCP configs do not expand plugin paths; portable configs force cwd into plugin/data, losing the active project.
